text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower suffers an injury during training, so I bring her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Now that I'm all patched up, let's get back to training.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I think I… No! I am! Really!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Besides, it wouldn't feel right to take a break over an injury this minor… So, please!
choice_data_list: Pushing yourself so hard doesn't make you grown-up.
Let's figure out what you can handle.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: It's best to err on the side of caution.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …You're right. It would be bad if I made my injury worse.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Okay, then. I'll just rest up for today…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower sounds rather disappointed as she returns to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Really?! Thank you, Trainer! Okay, then! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huff… huff… I should be okay at this speed…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I felt a jolt in my leg…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sorry. I said I was fine, but I don't think I can push on today…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We decide that trying to do any more would prove fruitless, and Nishino Flower goes back to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: This is great! Trainer, light jogging doesn't hurt at all!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I don't think I can do much more than this for a while, but I hope you won't mind!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A joyful Nishino Flower successfully completes her training session while taking care not to aggravate her injury.
